notes:
• Images that MCP and other tools return now reach models that take images; others get a short placeholder instead of pages of text.
• Each request sends only your latest 3 tool images, so a long session's screenshots don't pile up in every request.
• The desktop app now finds updates on zergai.com, so new releases no longer wait on GitHub Pages; older apps need one update by hand.
